title: Canonical hover occurrence binding (compiler Task 1)
description: One full citation-carrier edge from a source-addressed Qur'anic occurrence to a canonical payload identity. Accepted bindings carry canonical_wbw_loc, entry_id, card_id, and qword_row_id plus a required dependency hash. Waiver policy (owner-decided): incomplete carriers are disallowed; placeholder qword identities are disallowed; there is no generic waiver mechanism; a null or unresolved qword_row_id remains a fail-closed conflict until a real reviewed use case exists. binding_id is content-addressed over (canonical_payload_id, canonical_wbw_loc, entry_id, card_id, qword_row_id); mutable review, confidence, reason, and deployment fields are excluded. Finer-than-location bindings are legal and expected. Dry-run; source-clean.
migration: @2 adds card_id, required source_dependency_sha256, accepted-carrier requirements, and optional supersedes. Binding ids churn once because they are content-addressed over the new full-carrier field set; canonical_wbw_loc remains load-bearing and a corrected location therefore migrates the id. Existing @1 sample fixtures remain valid history and are not rewritten.

source_key.description: Citation CARRIER identity: the constant 'qamus' names the Qamus app as the source system carrying this hover, NOT a lookup value. RM-21 disambiguation: this is a SEPARATE concept from the repo-wide page-ordinal `source_keys` (arrays on the largelexicon-*-source schemas and Qamus entries, e.g. `qamus:{entry}#source_key={page-ordinal}`), which identify a source-photo page within an entry. Documented-only fork: the const stays 'qamus' (renaming would invalidate committed rows); the two `source_key`/`source_keys` meanings are distinguished by description, not merged.

binding_gate.description: RM-21 unified authorization enum -- CANONICAL (split) spelling: source_address_exact | certified_lemma | certified_pattern | function_context. This is the same authorization concept as the certified-lemma schema's fanout_gate, whose fused legacy value lemma_pattern_pos aliases certified_lemma + certified_pattern. See tools/validate_schema_coherence.py (CANONICAL_GATE + GATE_ALIASES); no data regeneration.
